title: Suikoden: Tenmei no Chikai
overview:
The blood of heroes boils, and Liangshan Marsh heats up! A host of exhilarating adventures, simulated in splendor. That classic game, once again.

This game is an authentic simulation game based on "Water Margin," one of the Four Great Classical Novels of China. As one of the heroes pursued by officials, your goal is to recruit heroes scattered across China and defeat Gao Qiu, the treacherous minister at the center of political corruption. Fully enjoy a world of thrilling adventure and action alongside heroes who perform feats in every direction.

The heroes' personalities shine! Game Features
- A variety of attacks, such as sorcery and duels, explode! Dynamic battle scenes with a full sense of presence
- Shi Jin, Lu Zhishen, Wu Song and the many heroes who liven up the story. An opening movie that fully depicts their appeal
- Enjoyable even if you don't know the original "Water Margin"! Includes a database packed with characters' anecdotes and nicknames
- Heroes, monks, scholars, merchants... a total of more than 250 characters
- Can you defeat Gao Qiu before the neighboring Jin invades? Tense gameplay with a time limit
- 4 scenarios with different selectable heroes and different situations for each hero
- A multiplayer system that allows play by up to 7 players

好漢たちの血がたぎり、梁山泊は熱くなる！
胸のすく冒険の数々を華麗にシミュレート。あの名作ソフトを、今ふたたび。

このゲームは中国古典四大奇書の1つ『水滸伝』をもとに描いた本格派シミュレーションゲームです。官吏に追われる好漢の1人となったあなたが、中国各地に散らばる好漢を仲間に加え、政治腐敗の中心人物である奸臣・高俅を倒すことが目的です。縦横無尽の活躍を見せる豪傑たちと共に、血沸き肉踊る冒険活劇の世界を存分にお楽しみください。

好漢たちの個性が光る！ゲームの特色
●妖術や一騎討ちなど多彩な攻撃が炸裂！ダイナミックで臨場感満点の戦闘シーン
●史進、魯智深、武松をはじめ物語を盛り上げる様々な好漢たち。その魅力を余さず描き出したオープニングムービー
●原典『水滸伝』を知らなくても楽しめる！登場人物の逸話やあだ名を盛り込んだデータベースを搭載
●豪傑、僧侶、学者、商人……総勢250を超える登場人物
●隣国・金の侵入より先に高俅を倒せるか？タイムリミットがある緊迫感たっぷりのゲーム展開
●選べる好漢や、各好漢の置かれる状況が異なる4本のシナリオ
●最大7人までのプレイが可能なマルチプレイ方式
